prior_summary: Live object-frame Cartesian targets make the carry/descent commands move with the freshly observed block while retaining measured robot posture and object-to-destination geometry.
applicable_conditions: Prefer for an open stable drawer and a plausibly held block whose entry pose is displaced from demonstrations, when two causal frames show the block and TCP moving together. Use primarily from the retrieval handoff through descent/opening.
termination_guidance: Yield when the block is at drawer-floor height and no longer follows TCP, or after upward retreat begins. close_drawer must not move the drawer until settling/detachment is observed; a destination-frame policy is preferred for the fixed handle transition.
limitations: Assumes a reliable object pose and attachment-like motion; does not prove contact or recover a dropped block. After release, an off-centre block shifts this policy's retreat/handle targets. Object-relative targets can still be unreachable or collide, and IK diagnostics must be honored.
